rounds.question: Explore an explicitly hypothetical trial. Finance should use calculate_javascript with units 120, price 25, and unit cost 17, then publish an illustrative bar chart of revenue, total cost and gross profit. Operations should publish a decision flowchart. Skeptic should challenge the assumptions. Chair should publish a self-contained interactive HTML quantity slider showing revenue at the hypothetical price. Each seat should do its own part. Label all outputs illustrative and cite executed results.
